title: Plastic In Artery Plaque Linked To 4.5x Heart Risk
hook: Plastic in artery plaque linked to 4.5x heart risk.
closing: The particles are nearly everywhere, but their long-term health effects remain unsettled.
question: How much plastic exposure can the human body safely tolerate?

segments.say: Plastic measured in brain tissue rose to an index of 4,900 in the comparison.
Researchers detected plastic in 100% of sampled placentas, showing exposure begins before birth.
Plastic in artery plaque was linked to 4.5x higher risk of heart attack, stroke, or death.
